title: Feature Hopper — mini PRD scratch
body:
Purpose / one-liner:
A tiny in-product scratchpad for engineers and PMs to capture half-formed feature ideas, link them to examples (logs, prompts), and quickly convert the best ones into a structured PRD template or backlog ticket.

Problem space:
- We have a ton of ephemeral notes in personal Drive docs / Slack threads that never make it to a backlog.
- Lossy handoff: ideas die because theres friction to formalize (naming, owner, impact).
- Need a low-friction place tied to sessions/context so engineers can jot ideas during experiments.

Goals / success metrics:
- Time-to-ticket: median time from idea save -> ticket <= 24h for 60% of items (initial metric).
- Engagement: 30% of active session users create >=1 hopper item in first 30 days of release.
- Quality signal: 15% of hopper items turn into triaged backlog items within 2 weeks.

Core UX:
- Small floating "hopper" button in Console and local devkit toolbar. Click opens micro-editor (title + 1-line problem + 1-line hypothesis + example payload + tags + optional screenshot/upload).
- Autosave drafts per-session. Drafts are private by default but can be shared to team or converted to ticket.
- Convert flow: button "Create ticket" prepopulates a PRD template + attaches example payloads and session trace (sanitized). Option to pick owner, priority.
- Quick actions: pin, star, export as markdown, export as PRD, attach to GitHub issue.

User stories (rough):
- As an engineer running a latency experiment, I want to save a short idea with the failing request attached so I can come back and write a ticket later.
- As a PM, I want to skim my team's hopper items weekly and promote high-value ones into the roadmap.
- As an SRE, I want to flag a saved item as a reliability concern and route to SRE queue.

Technical notes / constraints:
- Persist storage: use per-user encrypted KV with optional org-sharing. For Hosted API customers, store in their org namespace when in Console.
- Session context: capture last N request traces + model + route + token counts (strip PII). Attach as .json blob (sanitized).
- Export connectors: small integration points to Jira/GH/Linear; initial MVP will target Jira only (PROD-2451 is the sample integration ticket).
- Minimal server-side footprint: hopper metadata small (title, tags, pointers). Attachments stored in existing blobstore used by Console (re-use policy/s3 bucket).

MVP scope (conservative):
- Floating hopper in Console + Console mobile web (no local devkit yet).
- Create/Edit/Delete hopper items (private).
- Convert to Jira (manual choose project+issue type).
- Session trace attach (sanitized).
- Simple tag/filter UI.

Potential stretch ideas:
- Team hopper views and weekly digest emails.
- Auto-suggest tags based on trace heuristics (latency, error-rate).
- Lightweight upvote flow for ideas and a tiny ranking algorithm.
- In-Console collaborative editing for shared drafts.

Open questions / risks:
- Privacy: what exactly to redact from session traces? need legal sign-off on telemetry retention.
- Ownership: if item created during shared session, who owns by default? user or org?
- Spam/noise: risk of hopper becoming dumping ground. Need friction/quality signals (e.g., must add hypothesis or at least 1 tag to convert).

Rollout plan (sketch):
- Week 0–2: prototype UI in Console (client-side only, local storage).
- Week 3–6: simple backend persistence + export-to-Jira hooks, internal dogfood with eng teams.
- Week 7–10: iterate on filtering, attach session trace sanitization, enable org-sharing.
- Post-MVP: add upvotes, weekly digest, devkit integration.

Open TODOs (me):
- [ ] Confirm retention policy with security (ping @mika in Slack).
- [ ] Draft sanitized trace schema and share with SRE for review.
- [ ] Wire minimal Jira OAuth flow with auth team (see PROD-2451).
- [ ] Quick mockups for micro-editor (ask Drew for 1-hour pairing).

Notes to self / loose ideas:
- Could be marketed internally as "idea capture for experiments" — low ceremony, high context.
- Consider light ML-assisted title suggestion from first sentence + inferred tags. Cheap win.
- For Private customers, default to storing hopper items in customer's VPC blobstore when running private control plane.

References:
- See Slack thread #product-ideation (June 12) where Tomas suggested "attachments + session trace" flow.
- Related internal doc: /shared_drives/product/epics/idea-handoffs (do we need to link?).

If this still looks promising: next step is 1) quick Figma mock + 2) prototype client-only flow for internal dogfood.

---
Metadata quick snapshot: intended audience = internal PMs + engineers; primary value = reduce friction from idea -> execution by preserving context.

End of scratchpad.
